messages.subject: Re: How to transformation the categoriesor ordered data into a normal distribution
parts: What is the general format or package for Lavaan to transformation the non normal categorical data to a normal distribution using a truncated normal

Truncated normal is still continuous, not categorical.  Not sure what you are asking, but lavaan doesn't transform categorical data.  It uses a probit model, merely assuming there is a latent normal response underlying each categorical outcome.  It doesn't calculate the values of the latent responses.

https://www.statmodel.com/download/webnotes/CatMGLong.pdf
